skills.name: Doom Shield

specializations.effect: Resets cooldown on defeating an enemy

skills.summary: Deals 175.75% ATK + 173 damage to up to 4 enemies within 4m; 60% chance to Stun for 3s (guaranteed against NPC targets). Triggers Judgment for 2s; 10 Stagger Gauge Damage.

specializations.effect: Removes MP cost and restores 200 MP on hit
